So consumption per mile = 8.2 / 62.1371 = 0.132 L/mile. For 980 miles, liters needed = 0.132 * 980 = 129.36 L. Convert to gallons: 129.36 / 3.78541 = 34.18 gallons. So need 34.18 gallons total.
